strategy: Implement in 5 commits: 1) Add characterisation test for SessionEnded arm, 2) Refactor SessionEnded into apply_session_ended with char-for-charequivalence, 3) Add fallback infrastructure (dedup guard, URL helper, state fields), 4) Implement HTTP fallback logic with triggers, 5) Add comprehensive tests. Preserve compilability by sequencing refactor before new logic and isolating shared helpers.

commit_order.title: Add characterisation test for SessionEnded arm
commit_order.changes_summary: Create test_apply_session_ended_char_for_char capturing state mutations before/after SessionEnded arm execution

commit_order.title: Refactor SessionEnded into apply_session_ended
commit_order.changes_summary: Extract SessionEnded arm body into apply_session_ended function with identical behavior. Add SessionEndOrigin::WsReal call site. Preserve CSV URL derivation logic.

commit_order.title: Add fallback infrastructure
commit_order.changes_summary: 1) Add last_applied_session_end to AppState 2) Add active_billing_session_id_set_at to FailureMonitorState 3) Implement http_base_from_ws helper 4) Add SessionEndOrigin and SynthReason enums 5) Implement refresh_summary_card helper 6) Update apply_session_ended with dedup guard and upgrade path
commit_order.rollback: Revert state field additions and enum definitions; restore previous apply_session_ended signature

commit_order.title: Implement HTTP fallback logic
commit_order.changes_summary: 1) Implement fetch_and_reconcile with 60s grace/X-Service-Key/pod_id filter/status gate 2) Add T1 trigger after reconnect 3) Spawn T2 periodic task with CancellationToken 4) Add fallback_version telemetry markers 5) Plumb cancellation token from main shutdown

commit_order.title: Add fallback tests
commit_order.changes_summary: Add unit/integration tests for dedup behavior, HTTP status gating, grace period, pod filtering, cancellation, and telemetry markers

key_design_decisions.question: Where to place dedup guard state?
key_design_decisions.rationale: ConnectionState gets reset on reconnect - AppState persists across reconnects preventing duplicate applies
key_design_decisions.alternatives_considered: ConnectionState storage (rejected due to reconnect resets)

key_design_decisions.question: How to handle zeroed stats in synth?
key_design_decisions.decision: Use server-provided stats first, fallback to session_last_known cache
key_design_decisions.rationale: Balances server authority with local resilience; avoids corrupting analytics with zeros when possible
key_design_decisions.alternatives_considered: Always use server stats (rejected due to post-session-end clearance) / Always use cache (rejected due to staleness)

key_design_decisions.question: HTTP client error handling strategy
key_design_decisions.decision: Skip synth on any non-200 response or network error
key_design_decisions.rationale: Never synthesize SessionEnded on server unavailability - avoids false positives during outages
key_design_decisions.alternatives_considered: Treat 5xx as session ended (rejected as unsafe)

test_plan.coverage: Validates refactor equivalence for 16 state mutations
Verifies pod_id filter prevents cross-pod false positives
Ensures real stats refresh after synth without side effects

risk_matrix.risk: HTTP fallback fires during graceful shutdown

deploy_plan.rollback_procedure: Revert binaries to -prev versions via atomic OTA swap
